subject.title: Create example OpenClaw plugin using before_install

question: Should this repository carry an OpenClaw `before_install` example plugin now, and if so should it remain isolated from the public `clawscan` CLI surface?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested example, the issue is collaborator-authored and explicitly labeled for product decision, and VISION.md gives mixed signals by prioritizing ClawHub transparency while deferring plugin architecture for now.

options.title: Sponsor a focused plugin example
options.body: Approve a narrow PR from or replacing the named branch that adds only the example plugin, local docs, and real OpenClaw hook proof while keeping the public CLI general-purpose.

options.title: Keep the example external for now
options.body: Ask for the plugin to live as a separate package until ClawScan maintainers want examples or plugin packages in this repository.

options.title: Defer until scanner boundaries mature
options.body: Leave this tracked but blocked until the current scanner adapter and fixture priorities are further along.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a focused plugin example
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow PR from or replacing the named branch that adds only the example plugin, local docs, and real OpenClaw hook proof while keeping the public CLI general-purpose.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the default code owner and authored the off-main plugin commits tied to the requested work.
